about: Snapshot of the scripted month from the Clanker control plane. Written by site/export-data.mjs. Do not edit by hand.

scenes.name: quiet-week
scenes.title: A quiet week
scenes.detail: Seven days pass. The scheduled backup runs.

scenes.name: feature-release
scenes.title: Paperboat 1.1.0 is published
scenes.detail: A feature release with a schema migration.

scenes.name: cve
scenes.title: A base image CVE is announced
scenes.detail: Advisory PB-2026-014. The fix is release 1.1.1.

scenes.name: bad-release
scenes.title: Paperboat 1.2.0 is published
scenes.detail: A faulty release. The canary check must catch it.

scenes.name: kubernetes-eol
scenes.title: Kubernetes end-of-support forecast
scenes.detail: A forecast on the timeline. The local target cannot upgrade in place.

scenes.name: database-patch
scenes.title: Postgres 17.12 is pending
scenes.detail: A minor version patch of the database.

scenes.name: database-upkeep
scenes.title: Database maintenance is due
scenes.detail: Vacuum and analyze under the standing approval.

scenes.name: restore-drill
scenes.title: Monthly restore drill
scenes.detail: Restore the newest backup into a scratch database.

scenes.name: drift
scenes.title: Someone changes production by hand
scenes.detail: A manual kubectl change. The nightly drift check finds it.

scenes.name: incident
scenes.title: Incident at 02:00
scenes.detail: Inventory requests start to fail with no change in progress.

## What changes
`paperboat_version` in platform/stacks/local/50-app/terraform.tfvars: 1.0.0 -> 1.1.0. Nothing else changes.

## Why now
Finding release:local:1.1.0: Paperboat 1.1.0 is published and local runs 1.0.0. Release note (releases/1.1.0.md) read.

Release 1.1.0 adds fish aging, with a condition score and retirement. It includes schema migration 2, which runs as a Helm pre-upgrade hook in one transaction. The migration only adds columns. It is forward-only.

## Risk (medium, from the release note)
- About five fish with the starting stock are older than their species limit. They will retire within about a minute after the upgrade, as they come back to their tanks. `fish_available` will drop by that number.

- 1.0.0 keeps serving during the rolling update, because it works on schema version 2.

`fish_available` in `/api/stats`, and the `aging` lines in the worker log.

Revert this PR to set `paperboat_version` back to "1.0.0" and apply. No schema change is needed. The new columns stay in the database and 1.0.0 ignores them. Fish already retired stay retired and need a manual data fix if they should be restored.

explanation.sentence: Change the paperboat API from one replica to two, so it can handle the holiday rush (WI-0014).
explanation.why: The pull request from Carol Reyes asks for a second API replica for the holiday rush. The plan changes one resource: the paperboat Helm release in the app layer, where the replica count goes from 1 to 2.
explanation.downtime: None expected. The plan updates the existing release and does not replace or delete anything.
explanation.user_effect: No direct change for users. The API should have more capacity during the holiday period, so it should cope better with heavy traffic.
explanation.cost_change: The plan does not show a cost figure. Running a second replica adds compute use for as long as it stays on.
explanation.duration: The plan does not state how long the apply will take.
pre_checks: The plan is for the local environment, tier T2, and is not superseded.
The plan has one update and no adds, deletes, or replacements.
No deferred layers are involved in this approval.
explanation.backup: Not needed for this change. The plan has no stateful or identity resources, so there is no data to back up.
explanation.rollback: Set the replica count back to 1 and apply again, or roll the Helm release back to the previous revision. The plan returns a release revision output, so the previous revision can be identified.
explanation.verification: After the apply, confirm that the paperboat release shows the new revision and that two API replicas are running and healthy.
explanation.if_deferred: The API stays at one replica. If holiday traffic rises before this is applied, the API has less spare capacity. The plan was created on 2026-12-16, so if the cluster state changes in the meantime, the plan may need to be regenerated before it can be applied.
